findings.summary: Spurious French git-add error 'Les chemins suivants sont ignorés par un de vos fichiers .gitignore : docs/data' with exit 1, on a TRACKED non-ignored file (docs/data/cowork-schedule.json). git check-ignore -v exits 1 (no rule matches); .gitignore only has docs/data/cycle-snapshot-* patterns. 3rd occurrence (threshold per watch item) — 2026-06-06T00:09Z during c026 artifact commit. Despite exit 1 the file WAS staged. Likely interaction with concurrent git process holding the index (see GIT-MUTEX-BYPASS). Reproduce: git add -- docs/data/cowork-schedule.json while a parallel git process runs.
findings.evidence: git add exit 1 + warning, yet git diff --cached showed file staged; check-ignore clean on all 4 paths
